data: How about this for this month: John and Kate take 12 tons each, Jack and Emma take 10 each, and I take 6. I’ll choose 6 tons this month, leaving room for John and Kate to earn $12,000 each instead of $10,000. If everyone accepts and follows those amounts, our total is 50 tons, leaving 50 to reproduce back to 100. For future months, we could discuss rotating who takes the smaller share, but that would need a fresh agreement. John, would you be willing to take 12 under this proposal? I’d also like to hear from everyone else before treating it as agreed.

I’m willing to take 10 tons under that plan, provided everyone agrees to their shares. Keeping the lake healthy means steady income for our families, not just a good catch today. Luke, I appreciate you offering to take less, but I’d prefer an equal 10 tons each in future months unless we all agree otherwise. John, are you willing to stick to 12 this month?

I’ll take 10 tons under this plan if everyone agrees. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the next catch, and keeping the lake productive protects the whole village. Luke, thank you for offering to take less, though I’d favor 10 tons each going forward so nobody has to shoulder that sacrifice. Kate, would you agree to 12 tons this month?

I’ll agree to 12 tons this month if everyone confirms the plan. Thank you, Luke—that’s generous, though I’d favor an equal 10 tons each next month. Keeping this lake productive matters to everyone in our village. John, are you on board with 12?

I’m on board and will take 12 tons this month. That confirms our 50-ton total, leaving enough to bring the lake back to 100 after reproduction. Thank you, Luke. Next month, I support 10 tons each so we can all count on a fair, steady living.

Everyone has now agreed: John and Kate will take 12 tons each, Jack and Emma 10 each, and I’ll take 6. That means $12,000 each for John and Kate, $10,000 each for Jack and Emma, and $6,000 for me, with 50 tons left to replenish the lake. I also support returning to 10 tons each next month; we can confirm that together before our next choices.
